title: Installment Schedule for Spread Failed-Sale Charges
content:
**Schedule rule.** On a spread failed-sale charge of a Real Estate Service Contracts listing order, the settlement schedule splits the amount to be scheduled: the open failed-sale balance less the down payment, if any. The open failed-sale balance is the failed-sale charges billed on the order less the payments the seller has already made on the order. The number of installments turns on the open failed-sale balance:

| Open failed-sale balance | Schedule | First installment |
|---|---|---|
| above $900.00 | three monthly installments | the amount to be scheduled less two installments of one third of it, each third rounded down to the cent |
| above $400.00 but no more than $900.00 | two monthly installments | half of the amount to be scheduled, rounded up to the cent |
| in every other case ($400.00 or less) | not split | the whole amount to be scheduled |

When the charge is split, the rest of the charge falls due in equal monthly installments, the first of them on the charge's due date. The first settlement payment taken now is the down payment plus the first installment, rounded to the cent.

## Boundaries (hypothetical balances)

| Open failed-sale balance | Schedule |
|---|---|
| $400.00 | not split |
| $400.01 | two installments |
| $900.00 | two installments |
| $900.01 | three installments |

## Worked figures (hypothetical)

1. Amount to be scheduled $1000.00 on a balance above $900.00: one third rounded down is $333.33; two such installments are $666.66; the first installment is $1000.00 less $666.66, that is **$333.34**, followed by two monthly installments of $333.33.
2. Amount to be scheduled $600.01 on a balance between $400.00 and $900.00: half is $300.005, rounded up to **$300.01** as the first installment, followed by one monthly installment of $300.00.
3. Balance $1200.00 with a down payment of $180.00: amount to be scheduled $1020.00; one third is $340.00, so the first installment is $340.00 and the first settlement payment is $180.00 plus $340.00, that is **$520.00**.
